actions.name: Pause Tdarr node
actions.expectedEffect: Sets nodePaused:true on the target node; workers stop picking up new jobs.

actions.name: Resume Tdarr node
actions.expectedEffect: Sets nodePaused:false on the target node; node resumes accepting jobs.

actions.name: Pause all Tdarr nodes
actions.expectedEffect: Iterates all nodes and sets nodePaused:true; whole fleet stops accepting jobs.
actions.rollback: Resume each node individually via tdarr.resume-node

actions.name: Set node worker limit
actions.expectedEffect: Walks the node's worker limit for a worker type from current to requested. Warning: keep NasTNode GPU transcode at 1.
actions.rollback: Re-issue tdarr.set-worker-limit with the prior limit value

actions.name: Cancel running transcode
actions.expectedEffect: Kills the worker mid-transcode; progress on the current file is discarded.

actions.name: Re-scan Tdarr library
actions.expectedEffect: Enqueues a scanFindNew library scan for the given libraryId; discovers/queues new files. Side-effecting enqueue, not a read. Registry blastRadius is 'safe' but the executor relays a scan-files mutation, so it is classified reversible-write here and gated by confirmation.
actions.rollback: No direct undo; a queued scan can be left to complete or new queue entries cleared via node/queue controls. requiresConfirmation guards accidental fire. NOTE: needs a libraryId param — unreachable in the redesign unless the UI supplies one.
